about: Modwerk's Digitakt II base for OS 1.17, built by npm run machine:base -- digitakt-ii from core-dt2 1.1's source (sdk/imports/core-dt2-source-3d7c2e3.json) and Modwerk's own sources in sdk/machines/digitakt-ii/elekloader/modwerk/ (the sequencer's pitch, grid and phrase collections, and the active project's generation). One layout, identified by its SHA-256 in sdk/machines/digitakt-ii/base-binding.json (ce3e5488). The site builds every Digitakt II set on it. Stock-free: each site names its stock bytes by length and SHA-256, and the build fills them from the owner's OS.
